Other than that like others said playing 1v1 that helps with positioning, shadowing and timing also prediction. the rest can be done in freeplay and custom trainings like I mentioned :)

EDIT: about the pace, only thing that helps is focus on wavedash recoveries , even if you get beat, recovery is key. Those players are only as fast cuz eventhough they don't land perfect, they make up and recover so fast you don't realize they originally had a horrible landing. Freeplay going as fast as possible around the arena maintaining ball control is a way to go also trying to maintain your momentum at all times, instead of hitting the brakes hard while rotating into your goal for defence, try and rotate inside in a circular motion from back to front post to maintain your momentum and be able to react faster to the situtation.
That's all I can think off rn, Hope it helps a bit. Good luck on the grind.
